name: Habits

inputs.label: Title
inputs.description: The title at the top of the widget.
inputs.why: The widget shows it as its heading.

inputs.label: Habits folder
inputs.description: The folder with one file for each habit, such as meditate.json.
inputs.why: The widget shows your habits, their history and their streaks, and saves a check when you mark a habit for today.

prompt: Habits live in {habits}, one JSON file for each habit. When the person says that they did a habit, add a check for that day to its file. Before you create a habit file, ask the person once.
